approved_text: There are infinitely many natural numbers m such that m^2 + π(m) is prime, where π(m) is the number of primes ≤ m. (Equivalently, OEIS sequence A228828, listing these m, takes infinitely many values.)
draft: **Conjecture:** The OEIS sequence A228828, written a(n), takes infinitely many distinct values. Equivalently, the set {a(n) : n} is infinite.
source_docstrings: Conjecture: the sequence A228828 is infinite.
